title: CAN Configuration
text: Configure parameters for specified CAN device; {Device} sets the cAN device and channel, {Bus speed} sets the cAN bus bit, {Manually configure bit parameters} allows specifying individual bit parameters, {Synchronization jump width} sets the maximum allowed time, {Time segment 1} sets the number of time quanta before sample, {Time segment 2} sets the number of time quanta after, {Number of samples} sets the samples per bit integer, {Verify bit parameter settings validity} sets the check validity of settings and {Acknowledge mode} controls channel activity on CAN. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Device
params.values: CAN device and channel list option

params.name: Manually configure bit parameters
params.values: Allow specifying individual bit parameters off (default) | on

params.name: Time segment 1
params.values: Number of time quanta before sample integer

params.name: Time segment 2
params.values: Number of time quanta after sample integer

params.name: Acknowledge mode
params.values: Control channel activity on CAN bus Normal (default) | Silent
